title: No part of the app is free

body: My old boards got taken down in an update. Is there anyway I can get them back? I had a nice streak going.
author: LilDillthe1

title: Great Habit Tracker
body: I tried a lot of habit trackers. Others are way too expensive or overly animated and cute. This one strikes a great balance of easy function, polished interface, and a nice ripple animation. And the widgets are very well done. Highly recommended!

author: AbiSheico

title: Beautifully designed
body:
Updated (6/9/26)
Appreciate the updates. Keeps improving. Particularly like the new compact minimalist view. 

Few more requests:
- Time elapsed since last entry. (Relative dates)
- Photo attachments to journal entries would be a nice touch. 
- Still needs some kind of categorizing capability to filter/search in a long list or spotlight integration at least. Scrolling through a long list gets tedious when you have many things to track. 
- Reiterate the importance of an Apple Watch app to complete the experience.

Previous:
Just Needs filtering — Categories or tags (preferably) and an Apple Watch app. 

Other than that it’s quite appealing.
author: iOSBliss

title: Really addicting
body: I’m a developer so I can definitely understand the GitHub feel of keeping the streak up. Super simple and easy to use!
author: NevMthw

title: One of My Favorite Apps!
body:
Truly one of the most useful apps for me. I use it every single day. Reminds me of the good old days of Apps when they were useful first and foremost and not overloaded with bloat.

Edit - so happy to have compact boards now! One of the best apps keeps getting better and more useful!
author: random-task1

title: Actually goated
body: This is by far the best habit tracking app I’ve tried. Simple, clean, customizable, and you’re able to track easily from your Home Screen with the widgets. 11/10
author: Itsme879

title: Solid Habit Tracker
body:
The app design is minimalistic and user friendly. There is no extra gamification, no ads, no BS.
Just add your “ripple” for the day with 1 tap (2 taps at most!) and move on to the next thing. Love it.

body: This app became an essential part of my daily routine and it was great. I loved how easy it was to use, how reliable it was, and the lack of a subscription. Now UI bugs have made it unusable.

Great app, but I always leave one star reviews for apps that harass me with "enjoying the app? Please leave a review" popups. It's gross.

title: Habit Tracker That Sticks
body: I think when you see the little boxes fill up day by day, it is such a satisfying feeling. The joy comes when you’ve filled in every box for the first month, then you realise you’ve formed a habit.

title: Amazing app!

author: Kyle-Anthony

title: Checker is superior
body: After using so many habit trackers for years I stumbled onto Checker. It is easier to use, so you use it more consistently. It also reveals your habit pattern/frequency very clearly. The visual design is very appealing and well thought out. The developer is responsive. I enjoy using this app a lot.

title: Simple, elegant, exactly what I need
body: This is the habit tracker I needed! None of the overhead of these overly complicated trackers. Free version has good features. Can’t wait to try the paid version!
author: rampageraptor

title: One of the best Habit Trackers on the App Store
body:
I love how simple and clean Checker is compared to other habit trackers. I love how seamlessly it integrates with iOS from the Widget to the Siri Shortcuts. And it’s just a one time payment of $10 for the premium features in comparison to other habit trackers that are subscription based.  Can’t wait for more features to arrive. 

Hope Check In reminders are coming soon!
author: David Akh.

title: Simple and great
body: This app scratches just the right itch for lightweight generic habit tracking. I’m using it to track things like daily dessert consumption, cycling miles, and how often I remember to lift weights. As a SWE the github-style charts are appealing. The dev took feedback from me on Reddit and released my requested feature within a couple of weeks. It’s simple and great, thanks!

title: Wow. I have no words.
body: From what I understood from your Reddit post, this was your first app? This is incredible for a first, even for someone who already has experience in webdev. I love how intuitive it is to use, I love the features it offers free, and the fact that the premium subscription is a one time 10 dollar payment is incredible, with great features already there for both free and premium, but also more in the works! I will definitely keep this app and great job!
